points.text: M1: EITHER (weighted) average / mean mass of the isotope(s) / an atom(s) OR mass of one mol of atoms

M2: total number of electrons in lowest energy level: $2$
M3: type of orbital contains the electron in the highest energy level: p (-orbital)
M1: trigonal planar shape: $\text{Cl}-\text{Ga}-\text{Cl}$ with third $\text{Cl}$ below $\text{Ga}$
M1: Identity of correct gallium containing product: $\text{NaGa(OH)}_{4}$ OR $\text{NaGaO}_{2}$

M2: correctly balanced equation for reaction of $\text{Ga}_{2}\text{O}_{3}$ with NaOH(aq): EITHER $\text{Ga}_{2}\text{O}_{3} + 2\text{NaOH} + 3\text{H}_{2}\text{O} \rightarrow 2\text{NaGa(OH)}_{4}$ OR $\text{Ga}_{2}\text{O}_{3} + 2\text{NaOH} \rightarrow 2\text{NaGaO}_{2} + \text{H}_{2}\text{O}$
